text: Numerous studies identified the positive effects of GenAI tools in the formal language learning settings, but further efforts are still recommended to explore the use of GenAI tools in the Informal Digital Learning of English (GenAI-IDLE). To address the research gap, this study intends to figure out how GenAI-IDLE alleviate the second language (L2) demotivation through autonomous learning behavior and academic buoyancy based on the Basic Psychological Needs Theory and the Organismic Integration Theory.
source_label: The interplay of autonomous learning behavior, academic buoyancy and second language demotivation in the GenAI-assisted informal digital learning of English
